_comment: Schema by example. Copy to guild/config.json and edit. NO SECRETS HERE — passwords, tokens and keys go in .env and are referenced by name; any key with spec / token / key / secret / password as a word (apiKey, api_key, botToken) is refused when the file is read. Values still holding an example <placeholder-token> count as 'not filled in yet' and are ignored (a warning names each one at boot). Environment variables always win over this file. See guild/README.md and docs/DESIGN-guild-kit.md.

guild._comment: tag is the guild id written to every database row (SUPABASE_GUILD_ID). Pick it once and never change it. inGameGuild is the name as the game shows it, when that differs from the display name.
guild.name: Wolf Pack
guild.tagline: One wolf starts to growl. The whole pack will howl.

roles._comment: Discord role NAMES, as lists. Roles are flat in Discord, so the bot's allow-list is member + officer together; officer is the elevated subset.

provision._comment: How the provisioner treats your Discord layout. mode: auto | report | adopt | create | off. optional / skip: layout keys to leave out. createChannels: false = never create channels, only report. lock: none | <policy> for the permission lock. pin: pin the status posts.

opendkp._comment: clientName is the guild slug in OpenDKP (the <slug>.opendkp.com host). ranks are YOUR OpenDKP rank names: priority = main-within-a-family order, highest first; raider = ranks that count as raiding mains; raidAlt = alts that raid; nonRaid = never counted; newMain = the rank a freshly promoted main starts at.

raid._comment: Minimum character levels that count toward raid eligibility: altMinLevel for raid alts, popMinLevel once Planes of Power is the current era.

channels._comment: Names only. The join passwords for these are secrets: TAG_CHANNEL_SPEC / OFFICER_CHANNEL_SPEC in .env, each as name:password.

theme._comment: One set, with meaning. red = death / conflict, gold = a roll value, blue = a cast bar or link, green = healthy, purple = rare. Re-skin the set; do not reassign the meanings.

features._comment: pvp gates the competitive components (PvP /who collection, PvP timers). Overriding anonymous players additionally needs ALLIANCE_CODE in .env — a generated secret issued between allied guilds, never set by the wizard. Off by default on purpose. An env var FEATURE_<NAME>=0|1 overrides each flag.

expansions._comment: ISO date the named expansion unlocks on your server; boss buttons and relays for it stay locked until then.
